stages.event: You approach the entrance of Glacier, a frozen wasteland.
You see an icy cave and a frozen mountain path.

choices.2: Choose Intelligence to analyze the environment.
choices.3: Choose Happiness to explore the cave.

stages.event: A Polar Bear blocks your path! Can you scare it away?

choices.1: Choose Attack to try and scare it with a powerful strike.
choices.2: Choose Dexterity to perform a quick and agile dance.
choices.3: Choose Energy to emit a loud roar and scare it away.

stages.event: The Arctic Fox charges at you! Can you dodge?

choices.1: Choose Defense to try and shield yourself.
choices.2: Choose Intelligence to quickly analyze the situation.
choices.3: Choose Happiness to try and out-jump the fox.

stages.stage_name: Locating a FREE to open Loot Chest
stages.event: You see a shiny chest but it looks suspicious.

choices.1: Choose Attack to try and destroy the chest.
choices.2: Choose Dexterity to try and pick the lock.
choices.3: Choose Energy to use an energy blast to try and detect any traps.

stages.stage_name: Locating a FREE to open Loot Chest
stages.event: You see a genuine loot chest!

choices.1: Choose Attack to use brute force.
choices.3: Choose Energy to use an energy blast to open it without triggering traps.

stages.event: You've completed the quest and can now exit Glacier.

choices.3: Choose Attack to show off your skills before leaving.
